title: Generic Essentials Program
author: Matt
desc: Work hard, be diligent, eat proper, get jacked and become disciplined and cool.

ex.note: Rest at least ~15s (but under a minute for sure) between sides. On unilateral exercises like this make sure to switch the side you start with week to week to prevent accidental imbalances

Raise angle of bench two holes from the bottom. Sink DBs as low as you comfortably can.
Go to failure on last set.
1 side = 1 rep. Pause at the bottom, feeling a glute stretch for a second. Push these hard
Keep your torso straight, even crunch your abs in a little bit. Don't lean back. All the way up and down, hold for a second at the bottom (bar at chest) to control the weight
You will do these without weight at first, but once you pass 15 reps you're gonna pick up a dumbbell between your feet and use that (10lbs ish starting or something)

ss.note: Sink dumbbells as low as you comfortably can. Bench angled two holes back from the top
try to hold for a second at the bottom. set this up so you're feeling a big stretch in your hamstrings.
Keep these relatively clean. Put the thing at 3 or 2 (middle of range settings or slightly more range of motion). locking knees out bothers some people, see what feels good.

ex.note: Make sure your shoulder blades are moving all the way forward and all the way back. Like lat pulldowns, hold for a second at the end of movement. Squeeze shoulder blades back when you do this
